task.description:
Update the orchestration documentation and function references so the new registry layout becomes the documented contract.

Required updates:
- docs/agents/AGENT_SYSTEM.md
- docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md
- docs/agents/functions/fn-register-handoff.md
- docs/agents/functions/fn-create-handoff.md
- docs/agents/functions/fn-load-handoff.md
- Any other docs/agents files that still describe the registry as a single append-only file

Use src/design/registry-layout.md as the source of truth. The docs should clearly describe:
- active registry vs per-run registries
- ORCH ownership of the active registry and run-registry creation
- how agents resolve handoffs from run-local files
- backward compatibility during migration
- failure/recovery behavior when a registry file is missing or stale

Do not change source code in this step; keep it documentation-only.
acceptance_criteria: Docs mention the new registry split and no longer describe a single-file-only contract
ORCH create/load/complete procedures are updated consistently
Backward compatibility and recovery behavior are documented
No source code changes are introduced

result.summary: Updated the orchestration documentation and function references to describe the active registry plus per-run archive model.
result.next_action: Workflow complete for this stage / cycle
